audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Chronicles / Divrei Hayamim Aleph temple preparation and David's charge to Solomon, first-pass restored draft; later witness audit required
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for temple site, foreign-resident labor, materials, Solomon's youth, David's wars, peace language, skilled work, and prior inhabitants.

verses.restored: David said, This is house of YHWH Divine, and this is altar of burnt offering for Israel.

familiar.text: Then David said, This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

modern.text: Then David said, “Here shall be the house of the LORD God, as well as the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד זֶ֣ה ה֔וּא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְזֶה מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לְעֹלָ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: David commanded gathering of foreign residents in land of Israel and appointed stonecutters to hew dressed stones for building house of Divine.

familiar.text: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

modern.text: So David gave orders to gather the foreigners in the land of Israel, from whom he appointed stonecutters to prepare finished stones for building the house of God.

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד לִכְנוֹס֙ אֶת הַגֵּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד חֹֽצְבִ֗ים לַחְצוֹב֙ אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֔ית לִבְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: David prepared iron in abundance for nails of gate doors and clamps, and bronze in abundance beyond weighing,

familiar.text: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

modern.text: David provided a large quantity of iron to make the nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, together with more bronze than could be weighed

original.text: וּבַרְזֶ֣ל לָ֠רֹב לַֽמִּסְמְרִ֞ים לְדַלְת֧וֹת הַשְּׁעָרִ֛ים וְלַֽמְחַבְּר֖וֹת הֵכִ֣ין דָּוִ֑יד וּנְחֹ֥שֶׁת לָרֹ֖ב אֵ֥ין מִשְׁקָֽל

verses.restored: and cedar logs without number, for Sidonians and Tyrians brought much cedar to David.

familiar.text: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

modern.text: and more cedar logs than could be counted; for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought a large quantity of cedar logs to David.

original.text: וַעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִ֖ים לְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּֽי הֵ֠בִיאוּ הַצִּֽידֹנִ֨ים וְהַצֹּרִ֜ים עֲצֵ֧י אֲרָזִ֛ים לָרֹ֖ב לְדָוִֽיד

verses.restored: David said, Solomon my son is young and inexperienced, and house built for YHWH must be exceedingly great, for fame and glory in all lands; I will prepare for it. David prepared abundantly before death.

familiar.text: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

modern.text: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death. Solomon Anointed to Build the Temple

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִי֮ נַ֣עַר וָרָךְ֒ וְהַבַּ֜יִת לִבְנ֣וֹת לַיהוָ֗ה לְהַגְדִּ֨יל לְמַ֜עְלָה לְשֵׁ֤ם וּלְתִפְאֶ֨רֶת֙ לְכָל הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אָכִ֥ינָה נָּ֖א ל֑וֹ וַיָּ֧כֶן דָּוִ֛יד לָרֹ֖ב לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He called Solomon his son and commanded him to build house for YHWH Divine of Israel.

familiar.text: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.

modern.text: Then David called for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֖א לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֑וֹ וַיְצַוֵּ֨הוּ֙ לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: David said to Solomon, My son, it was in my heart to build house for name of YHWH my Divine.

familiar.text: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:

modern.text: “My son,” said David to Solomon, “it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God,

original.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר דָּוִ֖יד לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בנו אֲנִי֙ הָיָ֣ה עִם לְבָבִ֔י לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי

verses.restored: But word of YHWH came to me: You have shed blood abundantly and made great wars; you shall not build a house for my name, because you shed much blood on earth before me.

familiar.text: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

modern.text: but this word of the LORD came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.

original.text: וַיְהִ֨י עָלַ֤י דְּבַר יְהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר דָּ֤ם לָרֹב֙ שָׁפַ֔כְתָּ וּמִלְחָמ֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת עָשִׂ֑יתָ לֹֽא תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י כִּ֚י דָּמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים שָׁפַ֥כְתָּ אַ֖רְצָה לְפָנָֽי

verses.restored: Look, a son shall be born to you who shall be a man of rest; I will give him rest from enemies around. His name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quiet to Israel in his days.

familiar.text: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

modern.text: But a son will be born to you who will be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side; for his name will be Solomon, and I will grant to Israel peace and quiet during his reign.

original.text: הִנֵּה בֵ֞ן נוֹלָ֣ד לָ֗ךְ ה֤וּא יִהְיֶה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְנוּחָ֔ה וַהֲנִח֥וֹתִי ל֛וֹ מִכָּל אוֹיְבָ֖יו מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמ֔וֹ וְשָׁל֥וֹם וָשֶׁ֛קֶט אֶתֵּ֥ן עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּיָמָֽיו

verses.restored: He shall build house for my name; he shall be son to me and I father to him; I will establish throne of his kingdom over Israel enduringly.

familiar.text: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

modern.text: He is the one who will build a house for My Name. He will be My son, and I will be his Father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

original.text: הֽוּא יִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י וְהוּא֙ יִהְיֶה לִּ֣י לְבֵ֔ן וַאֲנִי ל֖וֹ לְאָ֑ב וַהֲכִ֨ינוֹתִ֜י כִּסֵּ֧א מַלְכוּת֛וֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: Now, my son, may YHWH be with you, and may you succeed and build house of YHWH your Divine as spoken concerning you.

familiar.text: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.

modern.text: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would.

original.text: עַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֔י יְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהִצְלַחְתָּ֗ וּבָנִ֨יתָ֙ בֵּ֚ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Only may YHWH give you insight and understanding and command concerning Israel, so you may guard Torah of YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.

modern.text: Above all, may the LORD give you insight and understanding when He puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God.

original.text: אַ֣ךְ יִֽתֶּן לְּךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה וִֽיצַוְּךָ֖ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלִשְׁמ֕וֹר אֶת תּוֹרַ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Then you shall succeed if you guard to do statutes and judgments YHWH commanded Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous; do not fear or be dismayed.

familiar.text: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

modern.text: Then you will succeed, if you carefully follow the statutes and ordinances that the LORD commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.

original.text: אָ֣ז תַּצְלִ֔יחַ אִם תִּשְׁמ֗וֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָ֔ץ אַל תִּירָ֖א וְאַל תֵּחָֽת

verses.restored: Look, in my affliction and preparation I have provided for house of YHWH one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, bronze and iron beyond weighing, timber and stone; you may add to them.

familiar.text: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

modern.text: Now behold, I have taken great pains to provide for the house of the LORD—100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, and bronze and iron too great to be weighed. I have also provided timber and stone, and you may add to them.

original.text: וְהִנֵּ֨ה בְעָנְיִ֜י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית יְהוָ֗ה זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֤ים מֵֽאָה אֶ֨לֶף֙ וְכֶ֗סֶף אֶ֤לֶף אֲלָפִים֙ כִּכָּרִ֔ים וְלַנְּחֹ֤שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶל֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁקָ֔ל כִּ֥י לָרֹ֖ב הָיָ֑ה וְעֵצִ֤ים וַאֲבָנִים֙ הֲכִינ֔וֹתִי וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם תּוֹסִֽיף

verses.restored: With you are many workers: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and every skilled person for every work,

familiar.text: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

modern.text: You also have many workers: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and men skilled in every kind of work—

original.text: וְעִמְּךָ֤ לָרֹב֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י מְלָאכָ֔ה חֹצְבִ֕ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֥י אֶ֖בֶן וָעֵ֑ץ וְכָל חָכָ֖ם בְּכָל מְלָאכָֽה

verses.restored: in gold, silver, bronze, and iron beyond number. Rise and act, and may YHWH be with you.

familiar.text: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.

modern.text: in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and may the LORD be with you.”

original.text: לַזָּהָ֥ב לַכֶּ֛סֶף וְלַנְּחֹ֥שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶ֖ל אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר ק֣וּם וַעֲשֵׂ֔ה וִיהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּֽךְ

verses.restored: David commanded all leaders of Israel to help Solomon his son.

familiar.text: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

modern.text: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon:

original.text: וַיְצַ֤ו דָּוִיד֙ לְכָל שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעְזֹ֖ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽוֹ

verses.restored: Is not YHWH your Divine with you and given rest around? For inhabitants of land have been given into my hand, and land is subdued before YHWH and people.

familiar.text: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.

modern.text: “Is not the LORD your God with you, and has He not granted you rest on every side? For He has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land has been subdued before the LORD and His people.

original.text: הֲלֹ֨א יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵנִ֥יחַ לָכֶ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֣י נָתַ֣ן בְּיָדִ֗י אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Now set heart and soul to seek YHWH your Divine. Rise and build sanctuary of YHWH Divine, to bring ark of covenant of YHWH and sacred vessels into house built for name of YHWH.

familiar.text: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.

modern.text: Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God. Get started building the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy articles of God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD.”

original.text: עַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֤וּ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְנַפְשְׁכֶ֔ם לִדְר֖וֹשׁ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְק֗וּמוּ וּבְנוּ֙ אֶת מִקְדַּשׁ֙ יְהוָ֣ה הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהָבִ֞יא אֶת אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֗ה וּכְלֵי֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לַבַּ֖יִת הַנִּבְנֶ֥ה לְשֵׁם יְהוָֽה

translation_notes: Foreign residents are assigned stonework; vulnerable migrant labor may be coerced and requires protection.
Temple materials depend on forests, mines, trade, transport, and skilled labor.
Solomon is young and receives a vast inherited project under public pressure.
David is disqualified from building because of extensive warfare and bloodshed; violent leadership has spiritual limits.
Rest is narrated beside subjugation of prior inhabitants, so domination must not be called peace.
The immense material totals may be rhetorical and must not support coercive religious fundraising.
Workers require safety, rest, compensation, and agency.
The site follows Ornan's pressured transaction and plague trauma.
safety_note: Do not use this chapter to defend coerced migrant labor, conquest, extravagant fundraising, unsafe construction, or hereditary ruler immunity. Center workers, Solomon's youth, prior inhabitants, ecological cost, and David's disqualification by violence.
